newsitem.title: UK: Russia wants to accelerate U.S. uranium deal.
newsitem.headline: Russia wants to accelerate U.S. uranium deal.

text.p: Russia's minister of Atomic Energy Viktor Mikhailov said on Friday he wanted to accelerate the delivery of weapons-grade highly enriched uranium to the United States under a bilateral deal signed in 1992.

From six tonnes in 1996, he hoped to ship 18 tonnes in 1997, rising to 24 tonnes in 1998 and 30 tonnes by 1999, he told Reuters while attending a Uranium Institute conference here. The original deal proposed shipment of only 10 tonnes per year for the first five years, and then 30 tonnes per year.
Highly enriched uranium is blended down for use in civilian power reactors in the United States.
But analysts said United States Enrichment Corp, which is importing the material, might be reluctant to accept the higher volumes because it would conflict with its commercial interests.
The minister said he was still negotiating with USEC over the volumes.
